procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: POL 3320 came to the race office around 16:50 for an arbitration meeting. Before the meeting, the damage was assessed and it was deemed that it may be serious.
POL 3320 was told that a hearing will be scheduled shortly with the first available panel to hear the request for redress.
A hearing was scheduled to begin at 18:10. The schedule was posted on the official notice board at 17:48.
Both helm and crew of POL 3320 were at the boat park repairing the damage to their boat, together with their coach and another person.
Some parts were needed for repairing the boat (glue), but it was neither the helm nor the crew of POL 3320 that went looking for those parts.
Neither the helm nor the crew of POL 3320 checked the official notice board at any time for the time and place of the hearing.
The hearing started at 18:15 in the absence of POL 3320 in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
conclusions: POL 3320 was not unavoidably absent from the hearing. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(1) for reopening the hearing are not met.
decision: Hearing No. 54 will not be reopened.
